in_sanskrit.name: Ashin
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Ash – Immortality, Shin – God
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ashin एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Ashin is a Sanskrit name derived from two roots: Ash, meaning immortality, and Shin, meaning god. This name is believed to be a tribute to the divine power that bestows immortality.
